label: preparing
what: Two hundred jubilee loaves for an inn hospitality arrangement, delivered to the great hall table chests; the innkeeper commissioned them and said he would settle the baker's account. Freight assisted with delivery. The record does not establish the jubilee's exact occasion, and the mayor was initially not told the details; by day 1, 07:04 the mayor was informed the loaves were ready and asked about them. Thus it was concealed from the mayor while planned/commissioned, but not throughout the preparation.
